# HolyfireMedia

> Your spiritual home for Malayalam & Kannada Catholic prayers, Christian devotional songs, lyrics, and karaoke tracks.

HolyfireMedia is a comprehensive Catholic devotional platform offering prayers, songs, and karaoke tracks in Malayalam (മലയാളം & Manglish) and Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ & Kanglish). The platform serves Christian believers and church ministries across South India and worldwide.

## Content Sections

- [Prayers & Devotions](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers): Catholic prayers in Malayalam & Manglish
  - [Japangal (Common Prayers)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/japangal): Our Father, Hail Mary, Apostles' Creed, Sign of the Cross, and more
  - [Japamalakal (Rosaries)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/japamala): Holy Rosary (Japamala), Divine Mercy Chaplet (Karuna Kontha)
  - [Vedapadam (Catechism)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/vedapadam): 10 Commandments, 7 Sacraments, 5 Precepts of the Church, 14 Works of Mercy
  - [Prarthanakal (General Prayers)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/general): Prayer for Priests, Prayer for Students, Three O'Clock Prayer, Precious Blood Prayer
  - [Madhyastha Prarthanakal (Intercessory Prayers)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/madhyastha): Prayers to St. Alphonsa, St. Jude, St. Anthony, St. George, and more saints
  - [Yama Prarthanakal (Liturgy of the Hours)](https://holyfiremedia.in/prayers/yamams): Syro-Malabar canonical hours
- [Songs](https://holyfiremedia.in/songs): Malayalam & Kannada Christian devotional songs with full lyrics
- [Lyrics](https://holyfiremedia.in/lyrics): Song lyrics in native scripts (മലയാളം, ಕನ್ನಡ) and romanized transliterations (Manglish, Kanglish)
- [Karaoke](https://holyfiremedia.in/karaoke): Downloadable karaoke tracks in Malayalam & Kannada — free direct MP3 downloads and pro studio instrumental tracks
- [Artists](https://holyfiremedia.in/artists): Featured Christian music artists including Fr. Joseph Mukkatt

## Key Features

- Multilingual support: Malayalam (മലയാളം / Manglish) and Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ / Kanglish)
- Dual-script toggle on lyrics and prayer pages for singing along and pronunciation
- Complete Catholic prayers, Rosaries, Novenas, and Catechism content
- Free and premium studio karaoke track downloads with instant delivery
- Clear personal devotional singing permission guidelines

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is HolyfireMedia?
A: HolyfireMedia is a Christian devotional platform providing Malayalam and Kannada Christian prayers, songs, lyrics, and karaoke tracks.

Q: What languages are supported?
A: Content is primarily available in Malayalam (മലയാളം with Manglish transliteration) and Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ with Kanglish transliteration).

Q: Are karaoke tracks available in Kannada and Malayalam?
A: Yes. HolyfireMedia offers free and premium studio karaoke tracks in both Malayalam (e.g. Aradhyane Parishudhane, Aradhana Aradhana) and Kannada (e.g. O Nanna Yesuve).

Q: Who is featured on HolyfireMedia?
A: Christian artists, composers, and preachers including Fr. Joseph Mukkatt.
